subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw keep this umbrella and split native tool batching, context-block lifecycle, and plan/workflow enforcement into separate maintainer-reviewed core/plugin design tracks?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, local context persistence semantics, new settings, and runner enforcement policy, and automation cannot safely choose those product, security, and compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan/workflow enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Move To Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Use existing narrower issues as canonical for context clearing and workflow gating, and keep or open only a separate native batching tracker.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Close or narrow the umbrella if maintainers decide context blocks and strict plan enforcement are too much heavy orchestration for core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan/workflow enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across planning, cache-TTL pruning, and prior product-review context for this issue family.
